description: Computes Australian state/territory stamp duty on a property purchase, including first-home-buyer concessions and the foreign purchaser surcharge where applicable. Example: { propertyValue: 750000, stateCode: "NSW", firstHomeBuyer: false, foreignResident: false, principalResidence: true }. Set compareAllStates: true to compare every state/territory for the same property value. Estimate for guidance — 2026 rates from official sources (IRS/Tax Foundation/CRA/ATO/state revenue offices/HMRC).

compareAllStates.description: If true, also return the same calculation for every state/territory.

firstHomeBuyer.description: True if the buyer qualifies as a first home buyer (applies concession where available).

foreignResident.description: True if the buyer is a foreign person (applies the foreign purchaser surcharge).

principalResidence.description: True if this will be the buyer's principal place of residence (owner-occupier); false for an investment purchase.

propertyValue.description: Purchase price / property value in AUD.

stateCode.description: State/territory code. Valid codes: NSW, VIC, QLD, WA, SA, TAS, ACT, NT.

name: au_stamp_duty
title: Australia stamp duty (land transfer duty)
